# /crav1-feature-candidates

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Feature candidates](../../from-feature-candidates.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-feature-candidates/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

List Feature candidates from the landscape, the specs, research, sources, and open notes in docs/notes/.

## Runs when

A list of Feature candidates. Called by the user and by [`/crav1-specs-to-ado`](crav1-specs-to-ado.md).

## Reads

In short: The landscape, the specs, research, and sources.

Reads `docs/system/landscape.md` (the spec index, Ideas, Way of working, and code with no slice), `docs/system/repos.md`, the glossary, every `docs/specs/*/spec.md` (milestones, slices, open questions, and actions), `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, and `verify.md` where present, `docs/research/` and `docs/sources/` with each fact labelled by its source, a stale research note shown as stale, open notes in `docs/notes/` labelled as notes and not as candidates by themselves, each spec’s `work-item.md`, and the landscape “No spec yet in ADO” table.

## Writes

In short: Nothing unless the user asks for a file.

Writes nothing unless the user asks for a file.

## Does not

Leaves specs, Azure Boards, and commits alone.

Limits and exceptions: a dated milestone or slice is one candidate. An undated spec with open work is one candidate. A spec that holds only open questions is marked questions only. An item with no spec is marked no spec yet. Done or retired with nothing open is skipped. A target date is given only when the docs state it. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option.

- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
